title: [Glimae'den Wildwood]
description: A break in the trees reveals a white oak trellis draped in sweet pea vines, their pink and purple blooms cascading down its sides in soft drifts of color.  Moss and fallen petals blanket the ground beneath the arch, the spent blossoms fading into dull hues.  The air carries the sweet fragrance of blossoms, mingled with the green scent of the surrounding forest.
